consensus_summary: Fans generally agree that the performance was memorable, particularly due to the atmospheric storm that accompanied the show, creating a magical experience. Standout moments included powerful renditions of 'Sugaree' and 'Stagger Lee,' which showcased Jerry's exceptional guitar work.
rating_rationale: 2.5 base + 0.2 for 28 reviews + 0.5 sentiment: While many fans had a great time and highlighted specific songs, there were also mentions of uneven performance quality and some disappointment with certain aspects of the show.
